tasks.short: Order parts, tools, and equipment for the field.

steps.what: Decide the parts needed to maintain the field.
Decide tools and equipment to restore operations.
Check the order against the stores.

tasks.design: The manager decides the parts, tools, and equipment, checks the order against the stores, and accepts it. Only that accepted order is sent. Nothing chooses a quantity or reorders on its own.
tasks.previous_blocker: The decision is what to order. Sending the same lines is a second pass.
tasks.enabler_now: A purchasing screen can send an order the manager has already accepted, line for line.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong part stops the repair, and the quantity is the manager's to set.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides the order and accepts it. The send is that version.
tasks.altitude: Deciding parts, tools, and equipment stays with the manager. The send is only the order they accepted after the stores check.

reach.task: Receive an order the manager accepted

evidence.claim: A purchasing screen can send an order whose lines and quantities the manager has already accepted. It does not choose the quantity.

Setting a budget, choosing an order quantity, judging warranty coverage, approving a contract, and selecting a person are decisions the wind operations manager makes. A tool does not make them. EU data-protection rules cover employees, contractors, and residents. Scoring a worker or a candidate is an employment decision a tool must not make. National rules decide who may bind the company to a contract. The file stores only what the manager recorded. Customer calls and hiring calls are not stored as audio.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a part, tool, or piece of equipment is needed and ends when the accepted order is sent. Choosing the lines and the quantities stays with the manager. Nothing reorders on its own.
The fields are part or tool, quantity the manager stated, site, and their acceptance. The manager produces the quantity. If a line is missing, they type it. The send is those lines and no others.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree on deciding what to order. They disagree only about sending a version the manager has already accepted.
Upkeep is keeping the part names on the order aligned with the stores list.
unknowns: Whether a supplier accepts an order only from a named buyer account.
What quantity, if any, is already fixed by a contract.
research_questions: Does a supplier accept an order only from a named buyer account?
What quantity, if any, is already fixed by a contract?

already_counted.description: Deciding the parts needed to maintain the field stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the part names on the order aligned with the stores list

approvals.approved_version: parts order the manager accepted after deciding what the field needs and checking the stores

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the stores check finds the part already there, the low end is deciding the parts and the tools, which stay. Only a send of an accepted order is shorter. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review, negotiate, and approve wind farm contracts.

steps.what: Check the draft against terms they negotiate.

tasks.design: The manager reads the contracts, negotiates the terms, reviews them, and approves the contracts. The send is only the version they approved after the negotiation. A tool does not agree a term.
tasks.previous_blocker: Negotiation is the meeting. Sending the approved text is a second pass.
tasks.enabler_now: A signing step can send a contract the manager has already approved, without changing a term.
tasks.still_hard: A term on price, access, or liability binds the company, and only the manager approves it.
tasks.human_edge: The manager negotiates and approves the contracts. The send is that approved version.
tasks.altitude: Reading, negotiating, and approving stay with the manager. The send happens only after they approve the negotiated text.

reach.task: Receive a contract the manager approved
reach.learn: The terms were negotiated by the manager

evidence.claim: A contract can be sent after the manager has negotiated the terms and approved that text. The send does not change a term. National rules decide who may bind the company.

tasks.short: Manage warranty repair and replacement services.

steps.what: Judge whether the warranty covers the fault.
Manage the repair or the replacement.

tasks.design: The manager judges whether the warranty covers the fault and manages the repair or the replacement. The file stores that decision only after they accept it. A tool does not decide coverage.
tasks.previous_blocker: Coverage is a reading of the warranty against a particular fault. Filing the decision is a second pass.
tasks.enabler_now: A file can store a coverage decision the manager has already made and accepted.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong coverage call either eats the repair cost or refuses a valid claim.
tasks.human_edge: The manager judges the warranty and manages the repair or replacement. The file stores that decision.
tasks.altitude: Judging warranty coverage and managing the repair or replacement stay with the manager. The file holds the decision only after they accept it.

reach.task: Carry out a repair the manager judged to be under warranty

evidence.claim: A file can store a warranty decision the manager has made. It does not decide whether the warranty covers the fault.

tasks.short: Develop processes and procedures for operations.

steps.what: Develop procedures for transitioning to commercial operations.
Review the procedures for construction handover.

tasks.design: The manager develops the processes and the procedures for transitioning from construction to commercial operations. The file stores the procedures only after they review them. It does not write the procedure.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing the procedure is the work. Filing a clean copy is a second pass.
tasks.enabler_now: A file can store procedure text the manager has already written and reviewed.
tasks.still_hard: A handover step that is wrong is a safety and a commercial failure, and the manager writes it.
tasks.human_edge: The manager develops the procedures and reviews them. The file stores that text.
tasks.altitude: Developing processes and handover procedures stays with the manager. The file holds the text only after they review it.

reach.task: Follow a handover procedure the manager wrote
reach.learn: The procedure text was the manager's

evidence.claim: Procedure text the manager has written and reviewed can be stored. The file does not draft the procedure.
